messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert — streaming egress queue growth observed in us-west-2. GEN endpoints p50 ~140ms, p95 jumped to 1.8s, p99 2.3s. Active SSE connections backlog +18k vs baseline. Error ratio for long-poll stream frames up 3.6%. Paging on-call.

riley: oncall here. seeing the alerts. can someone grab backlog dashboard? link: https://console.redwood/ops/queues?region=us-west-2

mira: looking. KV cache pressure correlates with long-tail requests (seq len > 2k). batching collapse on some GPUs. suspect continuous streaming frames are amplifying scheduling jank.

jonas: confirmed — the mux backpressure metric spiked right when a customer bursted many 1-token streaming sessions. We should consider immediate mitigations: 1) flip streaming feature flag to force buffered responses, 2) emergency rate-limit new streaming connections, 3) shift heavy customers to dedicated routing.

riley: priority is to reduce connection churn and free up inference slots fast. I'm going to toggle the streaming feature flag to disable push frames for prod-usw2 only. will post command below. if latency drops, we can open a gradual re-enable plan. handoff to whoever is on next after the toggle.

mira: +1. also recommend reducing streaming connection rate for anonymous API by 50% while we stabilize.

riley: running admin toggle now:

```bash
# disable streaming push in prod-usw2 (scoped flag)
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood/api/v1/flags/streaming_push" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"enabled":false,"scope":"us-west-2"}'
```

deploy-bot: Feature flag streaming_push set to false (scope: prod/us-west-2) by riley at 2791234625. Change ID: ff-9843a

jonas: seeing backlog drop immediately. active SSE backlog down from 18k -> 1.2k in 45s. p95 for generation endpoints trending down to ~260ms. error% falling. Nice.

sara: support triage: we have ~120 open tickets referencing "streaming cut off" and ~30 customers on dedicated accounts flagged. Customer impact estimate: ~2.8% of active API sessions in the region experienced truncated streams in the 60s after the toggle. Preparing status message.

sara: proposed status snippet for status.redwood: "We are temporarily disabling streaming responses in us-west-2 to stabilize latency and throughput. Some customers may see buffered/truncated responses; we expect restoration within 2 hours while we mitigate backlog."

riley: good. post the status and mention workaround (set x-redwood-streaming=disabled to opt into buffered now if clients need it). Also DM largest customers with CS contacts.

alex: i'm taking the incident for next hour — riley, handing off at 10:15 PT. summary: streaming_push toggled off, backlog reduced, tuning in progress. next steps: monitor p99, run rate-limit increase for non-dedicated to prevent repeat, and run a canary for re-enable if stable for 30m.

riley: passing pager to alex. pinned dashboard and runbook in thread.

jonas: additional mitigation: applying a temporary connection-rate shape on the mux gateway for anonymous keys:

```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","max_conn_per_min":8,"burst":16,"action":"queue-or-drop"}
```

mira: implemented a soft-shaper (queue-first) at the gateway; will escalate to drop if queues exceed 2k again.

deploy-bot: Shaper rule applied to prod/us-west-2 by mira at 2791234850. Rule ID: shaper-211

sara: support update posted. CS notified top-10 accounts with direct contact list.

alex: observations at +5m after toggle: p99 down from 2.3s -> 380ms, downstream CPU utilization on inference nodes down ~22%. backlog trending down. continue monitoring.

riley: any visible side-effects? are batch sizes increasing causing cost delta?

jonas: small uplift in token-latency percentiles for high-seq customers (they get buffered responses instead of streaming) but overall throughput more stable. we'll estimate cost delta after incident.

support-bot: 2 high-priority customer replies flagged for escalation (ids 7891, 7912). CS assigned: sara.

alex: plan: keep streaming disabled for minimum 30m after metrics stable (p95 < 400ms), then run a staged re-enable to 10% of traffic, monitor for 15m. if good, increase in steps. if not, revert to disabled and extend mitigations.

mira: will prepare a canary script to toggle scope=us-west-2: 
```bash
# staged enable to 10% of traffic
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood/api/v1/flags/streaming_push/canary" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"percent":10,"region":"us-west-2"}'
```

alex: i'll own the canary. riley — handing back to you for a quick notes update when you have a sec.

riley: added notes to incident runbook and linked Grafana panels. continuing to monitor for 2 hours. will escalate to infra if backlog reappears.

sara: final note for CS: customers on Dedicated may be exempt from this mitigation; if a customer reports degraded experience, check tenancy before sending canned message.

alex: thanks all. keeping thread open for monitoring and handoffs. next update in 15m unless something changes. :white_check_mark:
